observed_failure_mode: Scheduler admitted unlimited independent work packages per wave, accepted mixed base epochs, and Promise.all returned on first failure before all already-started workers settled.
root_cause: Missing bounded admission, main-epoch coherence invariant, and sibling-settlement barrier in existing deterministic plan.
repair: Cap each independent wave using the existing four-package tuning baseline (policy range 1..6)
Fail closed on mixed base SHAs before any worker begins
Wait for all in-flight siblings to settle, report failed/completed package IDs and block downstream wave on failure
Serialize identical candidate heads and shared obligation writers even when paths do not overlap
Executor revalidates bounded wave admission for manually forged execution plans
prevention: Tests reject mixed-main plans and invalid wave budgets
Tests assert failed wave completion barrier and no downstream work
Regression prevents duplicate head/obligation writers and over-budget forged plans
